# Morgan

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)</sub>
- **Role:** author  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P16](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0016), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P4](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0004), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P18](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0018), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023)</sub>

- **Family:** [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Morgan is a short, stout lady. She has gray hair and dresses in a tweed suit.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Morgan is a brilliant and delightful conversationalist whose extensive travels have made her an excellent storyteller. Beneath her sparkling exterior lies a deep, genuine kindheartedness and sympathy that easily wins the affection of those around her.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## Traits

- kindhearted  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

Morgan is a famous author who wrote 'Edgewood Days' and 'The Rosebud Garden,' has traveled extensively, lived in [Toronto](../codex/places.md#toronto), and is [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) Grant's aunt. While visiting [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) with [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), she was hosted for dinner and a walk by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P7](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0007), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P33](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0033), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--pendexter.md)

Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) is a friend of Mrs. Morgan who accompanies her on social outings. The two visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) together as unexpected guests brought by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), where they were entertained by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with dinner and a walk.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P33](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0033), +2 more_

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

[Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) is Mrs. Morgan's niece. [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) brought the famous author along with Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for dinner and a walk.
